$comment: Single source of truth for the build. Everything else is generated. The pipeline itself is not implemented yet — see docs/roadmap.md.
$publisher: Must match the VS Marketplace publisher id (Cursor's gallery proxies marketplace.visualstudio.com) and the Open VSX namespace if we also publish there.
$icon: 128x128 PNG. Not drawn yet; packaging will fail until one is added.
$engines: Lower bound is the Code OSS version inside the Cursor build this pack was probed against. Cursor 3.16.17 ships vscodeVersion 1.128.0. Raise it only to require a newer Cursor. `npm run detect` prints the value for the locally installed build.

pack.displayName: Cursor Language Pack — 简体中文 / 繁體中文
pack.description: Cursor IDE 中文语言包（汉化）— Simplified & Traditional Chinese for Cursor. Replaces the official VS Code language pack and translates Cursor-authored workbench strings the Microsoft pack cannot see. 替代 VS Code 官方中文语言包，并覆盖 Cursor 写进内核的界面文案。

target.$verifiedCursorVersions: Cursor releases whose localizable surface this pack has been reconciled against. Empty until the first extract + translation pass. Probe snapshot: Cursor 3.16.17 (Code OSS 1.128.0) at F:\AI\cursor — see docs/research.md.

locales.description: Simplified Chinese for Cursor: the editor workbench plus Cursor-authored NLS strings. Self-contained; replaces the official VS Code language pack.
Traditional Chinese for Cursor: the editor workbench plus Cursor-authored NLS strings. Self-contained; replaces the official VS Code language pack.

full.$note: The intended published product. One extension declaring every enabled locale. Self-contained: it carries the vscode-loc workbench baseline plus Cursor-authored NLS keys, and therefore owns the `vscode` translation id. Do not install an official VS Code language pack alongside it.
full.$why: Cursor is a Code OSS fork. Language packs map one translation id to one file with no per-key merge. Translating Cursor modules that live in nls.messages.json (composer, agents, aiSettings, …) requires owning `vscode`. That is the same constraint as kiro-language-pack.

companion.$note: Disabled. A companion that only claimed Cursor extension ids would coexist with the official pack, but Cursor's built-in extensions barely expose package.nls.json (8 keys on 3.16.17). Almost all reachable Cursor strings live in the `vscode` id, so companion mode is not useful.

upstream.$ref: Pin to a tag or commit sha for reproducible releases. Prefer a vscode-loc snapshot close to Cursor's vscodeVersion (1.128.x), not latest main, so menu-bar NLS stays in sync.
upstream.$license: vscode-loc source and strings are MIT licensed, so redistribution is permitted. See NOTICE.

patch.$note: Phase 2. Cursor Settings, the Agent/Chat overlay, and similar React surfaces are not in nls.messages.json. A language pack cannot reach them. An optional install-directory patch (same idea as kiro-language-pack's patcher, or a workbench.html injection) is documented in docs/roadmap.md and is not implemented. Plugin first.
